identity: A plain ribbed knit tank top. Every edge except the hem is one of the wearer's own curves: side seams from the torso sides, the shoulder line from the shoulder arc, the neckline from the neck hole. Fits any body it is drawn on.

regions.note: shell. Points 1-5 are fit placeholders (side_right rev, shoulder_arc_right, neck_hole, shoulder_arc_left, side_left). Only the two hem points (0, 6) are free.
